bootstrap.limitations: Intervals are omitted if either condition has fewer than two independent sessions. Intervals based on only two or three sessions remain fragile. Prompt/source IDs are the paired unit across conditions.
bootstrap.method: within-condition summaries resample sessions and prompt documents stratified by LongBench task; backend/context contrasts pair source documents and resample sessions independently within each condition
